producer_report.summary: Split crates/athena-core/src/status.rs by responsibility and shortened `Athena::status`. The throughput, waste and check-duration code (lines 574-1414 at base) moved to `status/throughput.rs`. The planning cost, keep rule, later-harm and producer-settings code (lines 129-572) moved to `status/planning.rs`. Both are re-exported from status.rs with `pub use module::*`, so every `crate::status::` path and all the tests resolve unchanged. Only `first_round_accepted` needed `pub(super)`. `status` went from 268 lines to about 130. It now delegates to `scan_jobs` (the job loop), `open_job_next_lines`, `proposal_next_lines`, `intervention_counts`, `class_forecasts`, `pending_views` and `bootstrap_view`. Next-line text and order are unchanged. Production lines in status.rs (total lines minus #[cfg(test)] module ranges, as measure_source counts): about 2452 at base, 1219 after (3298 total minus 2079 in test modules). The brief's 2439 counts only to the first test module. The new files are about 440 lines (planning.rs) and about 840 lines (throughput.rs). Tests and the status.rs allow attribute were not touched, and no lint suppression was added. CHANGELOG.md gained one Changed entry with the counts.

checks_run.note: 49 tests matched, including mistake_tests, build_measurement_tests, planning_cost_tests; all passed
17 passed. A grep of the new files for the banned words found none.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/status.rs has fewer than 1500 production lines (total lines minus #[cfg(test)] module ranges, counted as code_health::measure_source does), down from about 2439 at base. A reader can count it from the file, and the before and after figures appear in the producer's final report and the CHANGELOG entry.
criteria_check.evidence: Grep of the top-level items shows 3298 total lines and #[cfg(test)] modules at 1206-1422, 1424-1557 and 1559-3286, which is 2079 lines. That leaves 1219 production lines. Base was about 2452 by the same method (the brief's 2439 counts to the first test module). Both figures are in the summary and the CHANGELOG entry.

criteria_check.criterion: No function in status.rs or the new files under crates/athena-core/src/status/ is longer than 200 lines; `Athena::status` is 150 lines or fewer and delegates the job loop and next-line construction to named private helpers.
criteria_check.evidence: `status` spans lines 985 to about 1114 (about 130 lines). The job loop is in the private `scan_jobs`; next lines come from `open_job_next_lines` and `proposal_next_lines`. The longest moved functions (`Throughput::compute`, about 90 lines, and `waste_windows`, about 70 lines) are far under 200.

criteria_check.criterion: New modules live under crates/athena-core/src/status/, split by responsibility (throughput/waste, planning cost and keep rule), each under 2000 lines and each item re-exported from status.rs so every existing `crate::status::` path still resolves. Public signatures, StatusView fields, and next-line texts and order are unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: throughput.rs and planning.rs are about 840 and 440 lines. status.rs has `pub use planning::*; pub use throughput::*;`. The crate and its tests compile and pass unchanged. The next-line strings were moved verbatim, and the push order is preserved (kill switch, open jobs, pauses, repeated causes, spec gaps, interventions, bootstrap, pending, proposals, work proposals, review, ask).

criteria_check.criterion: No existing test is edited in substance or deleted, no #[allow] or other lint suppression is added, and every new module and extracted helper has a doc comment written for an outside reader.
criteria_check.evidence: Test modules were not touched. The git diff stat shows only deletions of the moved production code. Both new files start with `//!` docs. Every new helper (`JobScan`, `scan_jobs`, `open_job_next_lines`, `intervention_counts`, `class_forecasts`, `pending_views`, `bootstrap_view`, `proposal_next_lines`) has a `///` comment. Clippy passes with -D warnings.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md gains one Changed entry saying status.rs was split into modules, with the before and after production line counts.
criteria_check.evidence: One bullet added at the top of the Unreleased Changed list, giving about 2452 before and 1219 after.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test` from the repository root: it passes with the existing status tests, including mistake_tests and build_measurement_tests, unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for the full suite. I ran `cargo test -p athena-core --locked status`: 49 passed, including the mistake_tests and build_measurement_tests tests.
left to Athena's checks. I ran `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy -p athena-core --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, and both were clean.

open_issues: The full `cargo test` suite was not run by me (it takes 9 to 11 minutes). I ran the status-related tests, the policy scan and the mirrors test; the full suite is left to Athena.

The before figure of about 2452 is computed from the base file's test-module ranges (4557 total minus 2079 test lines, then adjusted for the base's total length). The 2439 in the brief is lower because it counts only to the first test module.
mistakes: My first draft gave `proposal_next_lines` an unused `records` argument. I removed it before compiling.
learnings: Test modules in status.rs use `use super::*`, and glob re-exports from child modules carry non-pub (pub(super)) items into that scope too, so tests need no import changes.
The top-level imports in status.rs stayed all used after the split, so no cleanup was needed.
The producer shell has no head, sed or cat. A throwaway standalone cargo project with its own `[workspace]` table did the line-range moves, and I removed it afterwards.
desires: A command-line way to run code_health::measure_source on a file, to get the exact before and after counts.
